description: AI-powered data intelligence layer: web scraping, entity extraction, and structured data display with tables and charts.

dataModels: Entity { id, type, name, data, source, scrapedAt }
ScrapeRun { id, sourceId, status, entitiesFound, duration }
integrations: Cron or BullMQ for scheduled scrapes
architectureNotes: IntelDashboard shows scrape run history, entity counts by type, and source health.
EntityCard displays a single extracted entity with structured fields and source attribution.
ScrapeStatus shows real-time progress of active scrape jobs with entity count and errors.
Wire /api/intel/scrape to a background worker that runs Playwright + LLM extraction.
Entities are typed by category (person, company, product, etc.) with flexible JSON data field.
Sources define URL patterns + CSS selectors or natural language extraction instructions.
